[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Arts Major in History with Departmental Honors","groupId":"9d06883d-d8a5-4dfa-9ec3-01948b5641d8","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a cumulative grade point average of 3.3 and major/program grade point average of 3.5 in order to earn the Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in history with departmental honors.

","groupId":"e7a2b142-6f5a-4afe-aa92-01948b5641d8","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"a93f76c8-e6f8-4849-83df-01948b592621","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include:

","groupId":"14eb5bb6-982f-4863-8295-01948b592621","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"d572809e-cb90-48a9-b73e-01948b592621","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

2) Students must complete 60 units outside the primary discipline of the first major, regardless of the department who offers the course(s) in that discipline. (This includes general education courses, transfer courses, CPCE/EXTN units, internships, etc.).

","groupId":"812075b9-bc6e-4a72-9835-01948b592621","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"d7317d28-4e1e-423b-8085-01948b592621","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"b67b3398-d053-469b-a0e9-01948b592621","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"454c00d8-a3e2-4a07-978e-01948b59ab8e","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note:  Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"34b7bbbf-9edb-43ac-a6e3-01948b59ab8e","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"College of the Pacific BA Requirement","groupId":"e9c22e4e-1b02-494e-9721-01948b5d737d","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete one year of college instruction or equivalent training in a language other than English.

Note: Transfer students with sophomore standing are exempt from this requirement.

","groupId":"87e489c5-3b98-43bf-aca4-01948b5d737d","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"f55fcb39-ebfa-48b4-8ce7-01948b5d737d","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes: 

1) At least 40 units and 12 courses required.

2) Students who declare major in first year should enroll in HIST 050 during sophomore year; transfers must enroll in HIST 070 in their first year.

3) Special Topic and Independent Study courses may satisfy category requirements with departmental approval. 

4) For History and Departmental Honors, students must present their Senior Research Project at a conference approved by the History Department and maintain an active membership in Phi Alpha Theta (PAT).

5) Minimum 40 units and 12 courses from Sections 3-8 are required.
